adopted.name: rotorlens-blackbox
adopted.rationale: Written from the log format rather than from any existing decoder. There is no third-party decoder attribution or upstream to track, and the helicopter-specific implementation remains ours to extend under MPL-2.0.

conformance.roundTrip: validated against tools/blackbox-writer.mjs over every encoding and predictor implemented
conformance.realFirmware: validated locally against private Rotorflight 4.6 firmware logs; the published quantified claim is Rotorflight 4.6.0, one board, one flight, 134429 samples with zero body decode errors; see docs/BLACKBOX_FORMAT_NOTES.md for the exact limits

rejected.name: propwash-core
rejected.reason: Permissive and usable, but multirotor-first: Rotorflight governor, tail, and servo metrics would need independent validation anyway. Adopting it would have added an attribution obligation without removing the work.

rejected.name: blackbox-log
rejected.reason: Betaflight/INAV focused; Rotorflight field coverage unverified. Same trade-off as above.

excluded.name: rotorflight-blackbox
excluded.reason: Separate GPL implementation intentionally excluded to preserve independent authorship, provenance, and the iOS distribution path; do not copy, port, or link it into the shipped product without a deliberate license review.

excluded.name: betaflight-blackbox-log-viewer
excluded.reason: Separate GPL implementation; the same independent-authorship, provenance, and mobile-distribution boundary applies.
